from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metrics from a single company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g. YYYY-MM)")
    
    net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated Net Income amount")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of amount: 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    net_income_label: str | None = Field(description="Exact line-item label used in document")
    
    operating_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities amount")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of amount: 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    operating_cash_flow_label: str | None = Field(description="Exact line-item label used in document")
    
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet anchoring the extracted values")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
